title: Hands Full, Fridge Full
caption: Hands full of Halloween snacks? Say them out loud and Fridgeroo adds them. 🎤🎃 Free at fridgeroo.netlify.app
ytTitle: Add Food to Your Fridge With Your Voice 🎤
why: Voice add shown in one idea: hands full, say the items, they land in the list. Afro/cobalt and punch-list-text-end differ from trap/grape and spookyhouse/charcoal neighbours; Halloween snacks tie-in for Halloween eve.
